body.label: Trigger
body.html: You or an ally within 2 units is targeted by an Action.

body.label: Effect
body.html: A Golem aspect interposes. The target gains +2 Defense against the triggering Action, then suffers -1 Movement until its next turn.

surges.html: You or one ally within 3 units gains +1 Defense until the start of its next turn.
After this Reaction resolves, move one normal Condition between you and one willing ally within 3 units.
